Rust/Wasm transform hierarchy

Tests the real compiled hierarchy and TRS kernels against pinned Three.js r186. Requires the existing Wasm build at /pkg/f3d_runtime.js and the pinned upstream build under /upstream/three.js. No GPU is required.

The retained-object API is bindThreeTransformHierarchy(wasm, objects) from tools/compat/hierarchy_adapter.mjs. Call update() at an explicit matrix-update boundary and dispose() when done. Include all parents in the object array. This does not replace arbitrary source callbacks, camera updates, skin updates, or animation scheduling.

The binding packs its complete explicit membership on each update; only the native solve skips clean subtrees. Visit counters measure native solve work, not JavaScript snapshot overhead or end-to-end speed.
